Apple celebrates 25 years of Think Different with a global brand-film series

January 15, 2024

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple today announced Think Different: 25 Years, a new brand-film series honouring 25 contemporary visionaries — scientists, artists, athletes, activists — premiering globally on Apple TV+ and rolling out across out-of-home, print, and online from January 24, 2024.

The series revisits the 1997 Think Different campaign that anchored Apple's identity for over two decades. The original 60-second spot, voiced by Richard Dreyfuss, featured a montage of historical figures and is widely cited as the canonical brand manifesto of modern advertising.

"The principle behind Think Different has never aged," said Tor Myhren, Apple's vice president of Marketing Communications. "Twenty-five years later, we wanted to honour the people who are pushing the human race forward today — and to do it with the same restraint and respect for the audience that defined the original."

The campaign

The operation comprises :

  • A 90-second hero film directed by Garth Davis, premiering on Apple TV+ on January 24. Features 25 contemporary visionaries from 14 countries. Voice-over by Tilda Swinton.
  • 25 individual portrait films of 60 seconds each — one per visionary — released weekly on Apple's YouTube channel and embedded on apple.com/thinkdifferent.
  • A global OOH campaign deployed across 41 cities in 22 countries, with photographic portraits by Annie Leibovitz on 12x4m billboards, transit-stop installations, and DOOH digital placements.
  • A print campaign running in The New York Times, Le Monde, El País, The Guardian, and 14 other titles globally, with each spread profiling one of the 25 visionaries.
  • Microsite at apple.com/thinkdifferent with full bios, behind-the-scenes content, and a downloadable creative brief made public — a first for Apple.
  • A coffee-table book distributed to all Apple Park visitors and selected institutions, with proceeds to a chosen visionary's foundation.

The tagline returns

The wordmark "Think different." returns unchanged. It anchors every asset in the operation.

Performance expectations and partners

Apple has partnered again with TBWA\Media Arts Lab — successor to TBWA\Chiat\Day, the agency behind the 1997 original — for the creative work. Production by Park Pictures. Photography by Annie Leibovitz. Original score composed by Hans Zimmer.

Apple does not typically disclose campaign budgets or performance targets, but Tor Myhren noted that the operation's primary goals are "continuity of identity and brand world deepening" rather than direct sales lift. The campaign is timed to coincide with the Apple Vision Pro launch on February 2, 2024, though Apple emphasizes that this is a brand-identity operation, not a product campaign.

About the visionaries

The 25 featured visionaries include scientist Jennifer Doudna, climate activist Vanessa Nakate, architect Diébédo Francis Kéré, choreographer Akram Khan, neuroscientist David Eagleman, novelist Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, and 19 others spanning 14 countries.
